All 1350 relevant simple cycles and 1656 disjoint-cycle triples are enumerated. The torus vectors have exactly 96 integral unit pivots, with rank 92 at maximum cycle length 11 and rank 96 at length 12. Their 96x96 unimodular minor forces an integral lattice basis of the primitive kernel, not just rational independence. The 92 initial columns are part of that basis and the quotient is free rank four. The only nonstandard premises, graph identity and degree-three chain boundary normalization, are independently explicit in the two standalone files and were executed from the current package source paths. The homology-model comparison is justified by published graph-braid theory.

value.rationale: The truncated cube has eight distinguished triangular and six octagonal faces; it is geometrically motivated to ask whether face-supported product motions generate the full H3 of three moving particles, and at which first nonfacial cycle length the integral lattice closes. The answer, four primitive missing classes requiring constituent 12-cycles despite allowing all 9–11-cycles, provides a sharp, natural support-length threshold and integral lattice quotient. The 96-dimensional basis is explicit and reproducible; the result is not a routine topology exercise or merely a minor variation of a known table.
